d: Felicity is pained by Ben's chilly silence after Noel revealed that he and Felicity slept together  Noel wallows in self-destructive behavior.
Everyone is stunned when Ben shows up at Felicity's Thanksgiving dinner with a date  Noel's behavior spirals out of control, and he winds up in handcuffs.
Javier tries to get Felicity and Ben to make up  a psychiatrist diagnoses depression and recommends therapy for Noel.
A snowstorm strands Felicity at the airport when she tries to leave for winter break, while Ben races to find her in order to make things right.
Lauren informs Ben that she got pregnant from their one-night stand  Felicity stresses about her future as an artist.
Ben struggles with how big a part he will play in his child's life  Felicity begins spending time with an architecture student.
When Lauren tells Ben she is moving to Arizona, Ben blames Felicity for their unraveling relationship and decides to move as well.
Felicity has trouble concentrating on school when she senses Ben is drifting toward Lauren and her baby  Noel dates his boss's daughter.
